name: @dadi/opentcs
description: DSH plugin: natural-language control & monitoring for openTCS-based vehicle/AGV fleets (host side). Bridges DSH agent tools to the openTCS kernel REST Web API v1.

scripts.smoke: node -e "import('./lib/index.js').then(m => { const ok = m.name === 'opentcs' && typeof m.apply === 'function' && m.Config !== undefined; console.log(ok ? 'smoke OK: name=' + m.name + ' apply=function Config=' + typeof m.Config : 'smoke FAIL'); process.exit(ok ? 0 : 1); })"
